title: USPTO Patent Center
description: Documented public official patent filing system (United States Patent and Trademark Office) for the Automated Patent-Style Invention Documenter capability area.
body:
USPTO Patent Center is a documented official patent filing system from United States Patent and Trademark Office. The USPTO's official electronic filing and docket system for US patent applications, including structured specification, claims, drawings, and fee workflows.

How it works: It works by assembling an independent claim from the invention's elements and hanging dependent claims beneath it, checking antecedent basis so every 'said' element was properly introduced.

Documented uses of this capability area include corporate innovation programs, patent landscaping for R&D strategy, open-innovation challenges, and systematic inventive-problem-solving training.

title: WIPO PATENTSCOPE
description: Documented public global patent database (World Intellectual Property Organization) for the Automated Patent-Style Invention Documenter capability area.
body:
WIPO PATENTSCOPE is a documented global patent database from World Intellectual Property Organization. WIPO's free database of 100M+ patent documents including PCT applications, with full-text search, chemical structure search, and national-phase tracking.

How it works: It works by tokenizing the query and each document, computing Jaccard similarity over term sets, and ranking the archive so the closest prior art surfaces first.
